#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD1 = 998244353;
const long long MOD2 = 1000000007;

long long read_input() {
    long long result = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    char ch = getchar();
    while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
        if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
        ch = getchar();
    }
    while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
        result = (result << 1) + (result << 3) + (ch - '0');
        ch = getchar();
    }
    return result * sign;
}

long long n;
vector<int> v[10];
long long sum[10];
long long cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0, ans = 0;
int pw[7] = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

void dfs1(int len, long long val) {
    if (len > 6) return;
    v[len].push_back((cnt1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1);
    sum[len] += (cnt1 - val + MOD1) % MOD1;
    ++cnt1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 9; ++i) {
        dfs1(len + 1, val * 10 + i);
    }
}

bool check(long long x) {
    return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && x * 10000000 > n;
}

void dfs2(int len, long long val) {
    if (val > n) return;
    if (check(val)) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            long long v1 = ((cnt2 + 1 - val * pw[i]) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1;
            int num = lower_bound(v[i].begin(), v[i].end(), (int)(MOD1 - v1)) - v[i].begin();
            ans = (ans + (sum[i] + v[i].size() * v1 - 1LL * MOD1 * (v[i].size() - num))) % MOD2;
        }
        cnt2 += cnt1;
    } else {
        if (len) ++cnt2;
        ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - val) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
        for (int i = (!len); i <= 9; ++i) {
            dfs2(len + 1, val * 10 + i);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    n = read_input();
    dfs1(0, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
        sort(v[i].begin(), v[i].end());
    }
    dfs2(0, 0);
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
